summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy's New Style in India
items.text: Rory McIlroy arrived in India for the DP World India Championship wearing looser, baggier golf pants inspired by Tommy Fleetwood, aiming to refresh his post-Grand Slam approach while chasing Patrick Reed in the Race to Dubai standings.

items.headline: McIlroy Defends LIV Ban
items.text: Ahead of the 2026 DP World India Championship, Rory McIlroy defended the DP World Tour's new ban on LIV players during a press conference, highlighting the tour's firm stance.
